evidence: Slither detectors run on lbamm-core (30 findings: 1 high arbitrary-send-erc20, reentrancy-balance findings, uninitialized-locals) and amm-pool-type-dynamic (65 findings: TickMath divide-before-multiply, BitMath incorrect-shift, reentrancy-balance). Most are known patterns (delegatecall return, uninitialized struct members).
Aderyn run on lbamm-core: 88 detectors, report generated. Aderyn crashed on amm-pool-type-dynamic (fatal bug in aderyn_driver). Logged error.

Slither list_functions on AMMModule (2 external/public), ModuleFeeCollection (10 external functions: collectTokensOwed, collectHookFeesByHook, collectHookFeesByToken, executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers, getFlashloanFeeBPS, getTokensOwed, getHookFeesOwedByHook, getHookFeesOwedByToken, getProtocolFeeStructure). Full internal function listing reviewed.

Custom Slither detectors not available as CLI - MCP detectors used instead. Reentrancy-balance findings flagged on _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse and _distributeAndCollectLiquidityTokens. These are genuine alerts worthy of investigation (covered by H-R2-DP-03).

Deep architectural analysis of AMMModule: diamond proxy pattern, ModuleFeeCollection routing, reentrancy guard with flags, queued hook fee transfers. Identified _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers flag clearing at line 3190 as key attack surface.

Entry point analysis: AMMModule has 2 external functions (constructor, __activateTstore). All swap/liquidity entry points are on LimitBreakAMM: singleSwap, multiSwap, directSwap (all with nonReentrantWithFlags). ModuleFeeCollection: collectTokensOwed, collectHookFeesByHook (NO nonReentrant!), collectHookFeesByToken, executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers.

Call graph traced via Slither: _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse -> executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers (regular CALL to self) -> _transferHookFeesByHook -> SafeERC20.safeTransfer (callback vector). _flashLoan -> flashloanCallback (callback to executor) -> balance check after callback.

Medusa cannot fuzz AMMModule directly (requires constructor arguments for wrappedNative). Used Forge fuzz tests instead: test_C20_fuzz_solvency_aggressive (25 runs, varying seed+numOps) - all passed. test_hypothesis_extended_solvency_50_ops (25 runs) - all passed.
test_C1_transient_storage_isolation_two_swaps_same_tx PASSED. Two consecutive swaps in same context, second unaffected by first's transient writes.

test_C2_reentrancy_guard_sequential_swaps_succeed PASSED + test_INV_H05_reentrancy_guard_blocks_reentry PASSED (MaliciousReentrantToken callback reverts). test_C21_callback_state_corruption_bunni_curve PASSED.
test_C3_reserves_track_pool_type_state PASSED + test_C3_tick_liquidity_consistency_boundary PASSED. After add/remove/swap, pool.liquidity == sum(position.liquidity) for active positions.
test_C4_conservation_across_operations PASSED + test_INV_L02_liquidityNet_sum_zero PASSED. Sum of liquidityNet across all initialized ticks == 0, conservation holds across 5 swap sequence.
test_C5_price_direction_consistency PASSED + test_INV_L03_price_consistency_after_swap PASSED. After swap, price moves against trader direction.
test_C6_comprehensive_solvency_after_mixed_ops PASSED. contractBalance(token) >= sum(reserves + feeBalances) after swap+addLiq+removeLiq sequence.
test_C7_no_value_creation_cumulative PASSED. sum(tokens_in) >= sum(tokens_out) across all operations — no value creation.
test_C8_withdrawal_guarantee_20_random_swaps PASSED (25 fuzz runs). After 20 random swaps, removeLiquidity succeeds and returns > 0 tokens when pool has reserves.
test_C9_flash_loan_swap_no_profit PASSED (25 fuzz runs). Flash loan -> addLiquidity -> swap -> removeLiquidity -> repay. Attacker balance <= initial balance.

test_C10_reentrancy_guard_blocks_swap_during_swap PASSED + test_C21_callback_state_corruption_bunni_curve PASSED. MaliciousReentrantToken confirms reentry into singleSwap/addLiquidity/removeLiquidity is blocked by ENTERED bit.
test_C11_collectHookFees_no_hook_no_error PASSED. With no hook configured, fees still accumulate correctly for LP, and collectHookFeesByHook doesn't corrupt state.
test_C12_depositWrappedNative_exact_amount PASSED + test_C12_depositWrappedNative_excess_refund PASSED. Exact ETH (no refund), excess ETH (refund), no value leak in refund path.
test_C13_sequential_swaps_two_pools_no_leakage PASSED. Swap through two pools sequentially, verify intermediate state not observable by hooks between swaps.
test_C14_addLiquidity_swap_atomic_no_phantom_liquidity PASSED. addLiquidity + swap in same tx at tick boundary — no phantom liquidity or stale tick state.
test_C15_cross_pool_arbitrage_no_value_leak PASSED. Cross-pool arbitrage with same token pair — neither pool leaked value.
test_C16_flash_large_swap_reverse_loses_money PASSED. Flash loan + large swap + reverse swap → attacker loses money (fees consumed).
test_C17_immediate_swap_after_creation_consistent PASSED. Settings consistent within swap immediately after pool creation.
test_C18_reserve_consistency_after_swap PASSED. Reserves after swap = reserves before ± amounts (no tokens created/destroyed). Halmos check running in background.
test_C19_settlement_conservation PASSED. Tokens collected from user = tokens disbursed + fees (balanceInAfter - balanceInBefore == amountIn).

test_C21_callback_state_corruption_bunni_curve PASSED. MaliciousReentrantToken callback during _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse() — reentry into singleSwap reverts with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall.
test_C22_read_only_reentrancy_safe PASSED. During swap, view functions (getPoolState) return consistent state. Read-only reentrancy blocked by ENTERED bit.
test_C23_transient_storage_stale_read_SIR PASSED. Two swaps in same tx — second swap reads fresh values, not first swap's stale DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT.
test_C24_cross_component_cork_pattern PASSED. Without real hook registry, verified that pool state is consistent across operations — no stale settings possible with SimplePoolType.

test_C25_fee_on_transfer_token_blocked PASSED. Fee-on-transfer token causes balance check mismatch at _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse line 2208 — AMM correctly reverts with LBAMM__TokenInTransferFailed.
